# Simple English Wikipedia

> > A free encyclopedia written in Simple English, making knowledge accessible through simplified language and clear explanations of complex topics.

Simple English Wikipedia uses basic vocabulary and grammar to explain concepts from geography, science, law, and other fields. It serves as an educational resource for English language learners, children, and anyone seeking straightforward explanations of encyclopedic topics.

## Key Topics

- European countries and capitals
- Geography and country lists
- Population data
- Quality standards and definitions
- Legal entities and corporate law
- Medical terminology
- Mathematical concepts
- Reference materials
- Albania, Andorra, Armenia, Austria
- Tirana, Vienna, Yerevan, Brussels
- Product quality and consumer goods
- Legal personality
- Clinical diagnosis
- Integer properties

## Geography and Countries

- [List of European countries](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_European_countries): Reference list of European countries with capitals and population data
- [New York](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York): Disambiguation page for New York locations in the United States

## Business and Legal Concepts

- [Quality](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quality): Definition of quality standards citing Philip Crosby and ASQ
- [Legal entity](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Legal_entity): Legal concept explaining corporate law and artificial persons

## Science and Mathematics

- [Odd number](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odd_number): Mathematical definition of odd numbers and integer parity properties
- [Symptom](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symptom): Medical terminology explaining symptoms vs signs in clinical diagnosis
